title: ComplexAccountRecovery
description: An account recovery API where users request a password reset, redeem a time-limited reset token, set a new password, and have existing sessions invalidated after a successful reset.
generation_notes: Return the same 202 response for existing and missing accounts when a password reset is requested.
Reset tokens expire after 900 seconds and must be checked against their expiration before reset completion.
Generate random single-use reset tokens and store them as a digest rather than storing the raw token.
Reused reset tokens are invalid, including after a successful reset attempt.
A successful password reset revokes all sessions for that account.
Keep reset delivery local and testable; do not require production email delivery.
